WIC28A-01.note: Few kills but vigilant, scattered, heads-up elk = intimidated; corralled refuted by scattered bands, chased/ambushed by low kill rate.

WIC28A-02.note: Voles settle near entry (not a corridor) and over half end in owl pellets; cafeteria pulls via seed-heavy grass, cemetery fits the sink outcome but is a slightly odd figure.

WIC28A-03.note: Cleaner-shrimp station; groupers rubbing on sand where shrimp were removed shows a health service = clinic. Canteen is the near-miss (shrimp feed).

WIC28A-04.note: Water drawn from deep reservoir floor = cold; trout replace bass. Churned/clogged refuted by spillway rolling gravel and gravel bars at old depth.

WIC28A-05.note: Port busier than ever and council-appointed harbormaster refute blockade/annexation/bombardment; wool vanished only from alliance markets = boycott.

WIC28A-06.note: Ground became parking lot, stones broken small = demolished; condemned refuted by sound walls, crated by broken stones.

WIC28A-07.note: Masts flat on water, crews on keels = capsized; becalmed contradicts the squall and blinded/beached are surface misfits.

WIC28A-08.note: Scavengers crowd in, strip flesh, scatter = a feast; cupboard (stored supply) is the only near-miss, bridge/battery are weak.

WIC28B-01.note: Netted flowers drop, probed flowers set fruit = pollination; patrolled refuted by caterpillars alike, propagated by fruit falling unopened under the tree.

WIC28B-02.note: Falcons took old/crippled birds, survival rose, count unchanged = rejuvenated; reduced refuted by same winter count, redistributed/rattled by unchanged nesting.

WIC28B-03.note: Licensed cheap editions paying her share refute pirated/plagiarized; praise refutes panned.

WIC28B-04.note: Orderly inventory, signed receipt, military use = requisitioned; ransacked refuted by the order, ransomed by refused buyback, repatriated by foundry/HQ destination.

WIC28B-05.note: Ingredients, sprouting/crushing steps with days, brewer's seal = recipe; receipt is the near-miss on amounts and seal.

WIC28B-06.note: Walk to a spring, drinking, votive ribbons, water for the sick = pilgrimage; roundup refuted by walking between grazing ponies.

WIC28B-07.note: Goods left for cash, redeemed for sum plus a tenth or sold = pawnshop; repository/parlor near-misses refuted.

WIC28B-08.note: Same wheel tracks pressed lower, water standing in two long lines = ruts; rippled refuted by flat braking zone.

WIC28C-01.note: Aphids slowed even on leaves ants had merely crossed = chemical effect, drugged; herded is a defensible near-miss (kept aphids from leaving).

WIC28C-02.note: Feather-light plank riddled with pencil-lead holes = shipworm; entombed refuted by open swept sand, encrusted by smooth plank surface, dismantled by intact outline.

WIC28C-03.note: Warm south face lets peaches survive frost = heat source; fence refuted by open ends, firebreak by river stopping the fire.

WIC28C-04.note: Rejects bricked up, marked destroyed, never reopened = dump; depository is the near-miss on cool dry storage.

WIC28C-05.note: Cores behind ivy pale/powdery vs bare half wet = dried; etched refuted by unmarked stone, fortified/dislodged by equal gale result.

WIC28C-06.note: Bare earth, stunted tufts, brown runoff = denuded; fertilized refuted by droppings washing away.

WIC28C-07.note: Exact copy except falsified channel and invented shoals at the navy harbor = doctored; flipped/enlarged refuted by line-for-line match.

WIC28C-08.note: Bed mud heaped on banks, pools deeper, no dams, water level unchanged = dredged; flooded/greened/deforested each refuted.

WIC28D-01.note: Clear water drained through sand, fertilized corn still pale = nutrients washed out; mulched/manured refuted by clear water, mired by on-schedule planting.

WIC28D-02.note: Exported stems feed cove shrimp = kitchen; kidney refuted by equal fertilizer/mud in and out, lung by oxygen depletion.

WIC28D-03.note: Village intact at original door height but cut off behind dunes, three-day walk = imprisoned; nibbled/lashed/lifted refuted.

WIC28D-04.note: Two divided communities attend together and form friendships = mixer; magnet refuted by ordinary local attendance; junction is a weaker near-miss.

WIC28D-05.note: Meltwater slot cut into granite = incised; milled refuted by soil kept, mantled/littered by debris pushed to one ridge at the mouth.

WIC28D-06.note: Press enlisted for war effort voluntarily, no prior review, private profits = mobilized; muzzled, nationalized, impoverished each refuted.

WIC28D-07.note: Rapid sand burial dominates (masthead only, 12 ft pumped away), so interred; mummified is a live rival via preservation from shipworms, and seawater as the subject fits neither cleanly.

WIC28D-08.note: Setting, money and names anglicized while content and rhythm kept = naturalized; lightened/manicured/mutilated each refuted.

WIC28E-01.note: Free crossing without pilot or toll, ships tie up at piers, swells break on bar and sheltered boats survive = seawall.

WIC28E-02.note: All trees survive, needles kept, but growth slowed and beetle defenses weakened = sapped; winnowed/toppled refuted by universal survival.

WIC28E-03.note: Size grading downstream and painted stones settling among same-size stones = sorted; stained refuted by color through the stone, sanded by fitting fragments.

WIC28E-04.note: Daily evening rise sets the mills' start = timepiece; thermometer refuted by static front, storeroom by spring-fed ditches, signpost by no road.

WIC28E-05.note: Spelling and punctuation regularized, word count and curses kept, dates per mother's own corrections = tidied.

WIC28E-06.note: Dam turned riffles into a slow pond, whole flow passes on = stilled; siphoned/soured refuted, walled weaker.

WIC28E-07.note: Crew lost with sealed hull = tomb; strongbox refuted by coal, tripwire by depth, trellis is coral near-miss.

WIC28E-08.note: Wine sales at the gate to drovers exceed rents = tavern; vault refuted by chests emptied each spring, scriptorium by purchased books.
